messages.subject: Project Willow - funds flow for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Catherine, Tom,

Attached is the completion funds flow. Total funds required at completion are £39,550,000, comprising £37,550,000 to the sellers via Castle & Vane's client account and £2,000,000 into the joint retention account. Grateful if Tom could arrange for the funds to be with us by close on 15 May so we can complete on the 16th.

James
